findings.what:
Because the check is `n > 1` rather than `n > 0`, the second line (index 1) gets no newline and no indent, so it is glued onto the first line: "a
b
c" renders as "ab
  c". Every two-line message loses its line break, and the forged `error[internal]` text ends up joined onto line one instead of indented, so the new test fails.
